The '''Vexar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Vexar]] and at least three [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including the [[third moon of Vexar]].<ref name="Ascension" />
